en.hubeali: From him, from his father, from the one who narrated it, from Al Husayn Bin Al Mukhtar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws

in a speech of his<sup>asws</sup>: ‘Place the matter of your brother upon its goodness until there comes to you what would overwhelm you from him, and do not guess as evil with a speech which comes out from your brother while you can find an interpretation of it regarding the goodness’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from his father from those whom he has mentioned (in his book) from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) has said in one of his speeches, ‘Deal with the issues related to your brother (in belief) with best interpretations until you receive overwhelming evidence to support the facts. Do not act on (evil) guesswork about a word that has come from your brother (in belief) as long as you can manage to find a place for it in goodness.’”
